# jenkins_folder (Resource)

Manages a Jenkins folder. Requires the `cloudbees-folder` plugin.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the folder. Changing this forces a new folder to be created.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the folder.
- `folder` (String) Path of the parent folder, for example `parent` or `grandparent/parent`. Leave unset to create the folder at the Jenkins root. The parent folder must already exist. Changing this forces a new folder to be created.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Full path of the folder, for example `parent/child`.
- `url` (String) URL of the folder in Jenkins.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# Folders are imported using their full path.
terraform import jenkins_folder.example parent/child
```
